description: Zero-code tracing, metrics and logs for .NET and .NET Framework apps on Windows Azure App Service. Installs the OpenTelemetry .NET automatic instrumentation 1.18.0 (open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet-instrumentation@v1.18.0) and activates it through applicationHost.xdt; point it at any OTLP endpoint with OTEL_* App Settings. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenTelemetry project.
title: Kjt .NET Azure App Services Extension for OpenTelemetry
